question: In Table 2, over what range was the steam mass flow rate varied in the solvent-to-feed-gas ratio study (Figure 7), and over what ratio range?
rendered:
According to the document, in the solvent-to-feed-gas ratio study (Figure 7), the feed gas flow rates were varied: 800 kg h^− 1, 1500 kg h^− 1, and 3000 kg h^− 1, at 1 wt % isoprene concentration.

The steam use is lowest near a solvent-to-feed ratio of 1.2, requiring about 1.7 kg of steam per kg of isoprene.

There is no Table 2 in the provided document.
